features: Recovery: Windows restarts a crashed or killed agent service after 5 s, 30 s and 60 s. The setup applies and verifies this on install and at every broker start.
Tamper check: the broker checks the service permissions, the service SIDs, the recovery and the agent folders at start, every 5 minutes and after a service change.
The broker restores a changed protection and reports it. It reports a changed start type, but never changes it back.
Tamper alarms: the agent reports a stopped, ended, hung or removed agent and a changed protection to the portal (capability agent-integrity).
Watchdog: the broker starts a stopped worker and ends a worker that hangs for 3 minutes. The worker reports a broker that does not answer.
A local --uninstall informs the portal before it removes the agent. Updates, portal uninstalls and reboots create no alarm.
New self-tests --integrity-self-test and --service-lifecycle-self-test (install, kill, stop and remove two test services).
fixes: The update staging folder keeps its protected permissions.
